answer: In an AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism like the Beacon Chain utilizes a spiral of verification and validation to deter fake identities. As new agents join the network, they must prove their identity by solving a cryptographic puzzle, which serves as a beacon to distinguish genuine agents from impostors. If an attacker attempts to flood the network with fake identities, the system will adapt by increasing the computational cost of puzzle-solving, effectively countering the tide of malicious activity and maintaining network integrity.
